description: This file contains test functions for the documentation internationalization (i18n) provider and model selection logic, specifically testing environment variable overrides and defaults.

methods.name: TestDocsPiProviderPrefersExplicitOverride
methods.description: Tests that the docsPiProvider function returns the explicitly set provider when environment variables are configured.

methods.name: TestDocsPiProviderPrefersOpenAIEnvWhenAvailable
methods.description: Tests that the docsPiProvider function defaults to OpenAI when the provider environment variable is unset but API key is available.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelUsesProviderDefault
methods.description: Tests that docsPiModel returns the default model based on the provider specified in environment variables.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelKeepsOpenAIDefaultAtGPT54
methods.description: Tests that the default OpenAI model is used when no explicit model override is set.

methods.name: TestDocsPiModelPrefersExplicitOverride
methods.description: Tests that an explicitly set model override is used instead of defaults.
